title: Language
description: The language module displays the currently active keyboard layout in the Mango compositor.

placeholders.description: Short description of the layout (same as {short} in most cases).
Full name of the layout as reported by Mango (e.g. "English (US)"). The empty positional {} in the default format resolves to this value, so the long name is shown when no format is specified.
Variant of the layout, if any.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how the layout should be displayed. See FORMAT REPLACEMENTS.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.doc: Action that pops up a menu.
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. It must contain an element of type GtkMenu with id menu.
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: Actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all leftover space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

patterns.label: Format <lang>
patterns.description: Provide an alternative format string for a given language. <lang> is the short description of the layout (e.g. "us", "de"). The value is used as the replacement for {} in the main format. This option can be repeated for multiple languages.

patterns.label: Format <lang> <variant>
patterns.description: Like format-<lang> but also matches the layout variant, taking precedence over format-<lang> when both the language and variant match.
